Wonder how Japan’s knee therapies differ?

PRP uses growth factors from your blood to signal the body’s own repair processes.
Stem cell therapy uses live cells from fat or bone marrow to actively regenerate tissue and modulate immunity.
Japan’s Act on the Safety of Regenerative Medicine requires licensed clinics and certified cell‑processing labs.
